In [[3627 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Arcona enslaver''' handled a trade agreement with [[The Brothers]] enslaver organization aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. He was then neutralized along with the other [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] by an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Yoke" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Arcona enslaver appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''. He is featured in the secondary and heroic quest "Breaking the Yoke" for Republic-aligned players. After his defeat in combat, the player has a choice to deliver him to the Republic authorities, execute him to acquire dark side points, or to let him go for light side points.<ref name="Yoke" />
